items.text: AMEND (T) AND RECOMMIT TO VETERANS' AFFAIRS
REFERRED TO MENTAL HEALTH AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES
VOTE RECONSIDERED - RESTORED TO THIRD READING

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to adding a representative of veteran and alcoholism or substance abuse programs and a representative who is a veteran that served in combat and is recovering from alcohol and/or substance abuse to the advisory council on alcoholism and substance abuse services

A.actClause: AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to requiring a representative of veteran and alcoholism or substance abuse programs and a representative who is a veteran that served in combat and is recovering from alcohol and/or substance abuse to the advisory council on alcoholism and substance abuse services

B.actClause: AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to requiring a representative of veteran and alcoholism or substance abuse programs and a representative who is a veteran that served in combat and is recovering from alcohol and/or substance abuse to the advisory council on alcoholism and substance abuse services

summary: Requires a representative of veteran and alcoholism or substance abuse programs to be on the advisory council on alcoholism and substance abuse programs as well as a representative who is a combat veteran and is recovering from alcohol and/or substance abuse.
title: Requires a representative of veteran and alcoholism or substance abuse programs to the advisory council on alcoholism and substance abuse services
